description: This Java class defines a message used by an actor in an Akka-like actor system. It encapsulates a sequence number to check for activity and potentially trigger termination if no new activity has occurred since the last check.

classes.name: CheckForActivity
classes.description: A message class used by the actor to check its activity status based on a sequence number.

methods.name: CheckForActivity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message with a sequence number.

methods.name: getSequenceNr
methods.description: Returns the sequence number associated with this activity check message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare CheckForActivity objects based on sequence number.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() to generate hash based on sequence number.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the CheckForActivity object, including its sequence number.
